clips.title: The story
paras: Fog shrouds North Coast along the Great Sea, where blight and murlocs shape the shore. Its cold sands lie at Tirisfal Glades' northern edge, littered with rotting marine life.

Before the Third War, North Coast's waters and stony beaches formed Lordaeron's peaceful northern boundary. The Plague of Undeath swept across the continent, and its blight seeped down the bluffs to poison the coast. The waters grew cold and murky. Now giant sea creatures wash ashore and rot on the sand beneath the lasting coastal fog.

With Lordaeron shattered, the Forsaken focus on Brill and the Capital City, while coastal murlocs claim the desolate sands. The Vile Fin tribe keeps huts along the surf and uses nearby shallows as spawning grounds. Ravenous murlocs gather there, including Deeb and growing tadpoles. They violently guard the tideline against surface-dwellers.
